name: Meeting Action Item Extraction
prompt:
From AW_Campaign_Notes/AW_SEO_Marketing_Sync.docx on the desktop, extract all to-do tasks and keep only those with a clear owner and a specific deadline or committed delivery time. Filter out directional suggestions (those without an owner and deadline).

Group by owner and distinguish them with level-2 or level-3 headings. Under each owner, list the tasks; each task must include: task description, the platform or channel involved (such as the official website, Xiaohongshu, Pinterest, Instagram, etc.), and the deadline.

If a task in the original text mentions “加急”, “ASAP”, or its deadline is within 3 days from today, add a 🔥 emoji in front of that task.

Output as a Markdown file and save it to AW_Campaign_Notes/AW_SEO_ActionItems.md on the desktop.
